question.problem:
Consider the function $y=\frac{(x+3)^{6}(x+8)^{5}}{{sin}^{8}⁡x}.$ The derivative of this function is given by

$$
{y}^{′}=\frac{(x+3)^{5}(x+8)^{4}}{{sin}^{8}⁡x}(ax+63-8({x}^{2}+bx+c)\operatorname{cot}⁡x).
$$

Find the value of $a+b+c.$
question.worked_solution:
We have the function 

$$
y=\frac{(x+3)^{6}(x+8)^{5}}{{sin}^{8}⁡x}.
$$

First, we take the natural logarithm of both sides and use the product, quotient, and power rules for logarithms:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡y & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{(x+3)^{6}(x+8)^{5}}{{sin}^{8}⁡x}) \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡y & =\operatorname{ln}⁡((x+3)^{6})+\operatorname{ln}⁡((x+8)^{5})-\operatorname{ln}⁡({sin}^{8}⁡x) \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡y & =6\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+3)+5\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+8)-8\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{sin}⁡x)\end{aligned}
$$

 

Next, we differentiate both sides with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{ln}⁡y) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(6\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+3)+5\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+8)-8\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{sin}⁡x)) \\ \frac{1}{y}\cdot {y}^{′} & =6\cdot \frac{1}{x+3}+5\cdot \frac{1}{x+8}-8\cdot \frac{1}{\operatorname{sin}⁡x}\cdot \operatorname{cos}⁡x \\ \frac{{y}^{′}}{y} & =\frac{6}{x+3}+\frac{5}{x+8}-8\operatorname{cot}⁡x\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we solve for ${y}^{′}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′} & =y(\frac{6}{x+3}+\frac{5}{x+8}-8\operatorname{cot}⁡x)\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute $y=\frac{(x+3)^{6}(x+8)^{5}}{{sin}^{8}⁡x}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′} & =\frac{(x+3)^{6}(x+8)^{5}}{{sin}^{8}⁡x}(\frac{6}{x+3}+\frac{5}{x+8}-8\operatorname{cot}⁡x) \\  & =\frac{(x+3)^{6}(x+8)^{5}}{{sin}^{8}⁡x}(\frac{6(x+8)+5(x+3)-8\operatorname{cot}⁡x(x+3)(x+8)}{(x+3)(x+8)}) \\  & =\frac{(x+3)^{6}(x+8)^{5}}{{sin}^{8}⁡x}(\frac{6x+48+5x+15-8\operatorname{cot}⁡x({x}^{2}+11x+24)}{(x+3)(x+8)}) \\  & =\frac{(x+3)^{6}(x+8)^{5}}{{sin}^{8}⁡x}(\frac{11x+63-8\operatorname{cot}⁡x({x}^{2}+11x+24)}{(x+3)(x+8)}) \\  & =\frac{(x+3)^{5}(x+8)^{4}}{{sin}^{8}⁡x}(11x+63-8\operatorname{cot}⁡x({x}^{2}+11x+24))\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
a+b+c=11+11+24=46.
$$
